records.name: Fallen Scavenger
records.location: Act I · reinterpretation of the Diablo II Fallen
records.layout: 16:9 sheet: front, side, rear and elevated game views; attack pose, black silhouette and small game-scale view.
records.description: Small hunched horned imp, wiry limbs, chipped cleaver, scrap-wood buckler, muddy red-brown hide and ragged leather. Cowardly melee swarm; crouched asymmetric silhouette.
records.art: Layout: four full-body top-row views (front, side, rear, three-quarter), human silhouette at left; attack, black silhouette, and smaller three-quarter view below. No cropped parts, labels, scenery, logos, or watermark visible. Dark grey backdrop with soft contact shadows; exact #3A3A3A uniformity was not measured. records.name: Fallen Bell Thief
records.location: Act I · Fallen family test sheet
records.layout: 16:9 sheet: large elevated three-quarter view with smaller front, side and rear views.
records.description: Grey-skinned hunched demon with long arms and asymmetric horns, carrying a cracked bronze chapel bell on a leather harness and a rusty hook in the right hand. First Codex CLI image test before the 20-sheet batch.
records.art: It includes a large elevated three-quarter full-body view on the left, smaller front, side, and rear views on the right, and one grey human silhouette. The grey-skinned hunched demon has long arms, asymmetric horns, a cracked bronze chapel bell with leather harness, a right-hand rusty hook, ragged waist cloth, and bare clawed feet. No shield, exposed guts, logos, watermark, or obvious readable text appears. The bell is prominent and visibly heavy.

records.name: Fallen Ash Shaman
records.location: Act I · reinterpretation of the Diablo II Fallen Shaman
records.layout: 16:9 sheet: front, side, rear and elevated game views; attack pose, black silhouette and small game-scale view.
records.description: Small elderly horned demon, stooped spine, tall crooked staff with a modest ember and bone charms, soot-stained hide, ragged mantle. Staff and posture clearly distinguish resurrection caster from melee.
records.art: View order, left to right: Top: grey adult human scale reference, front, side, rear, three-quarter view. Bottom: casting/attack pose, black shaman-and-staff silhouette, smaller game-scale three-quarter view. This is an original reinterpretation inspired by the Fallen Shaman family, not canonical Blizzard artwork or a faithful reconstruction. The funeral-canopy mantle, elderly hunch, waist ash tools, and ember staff establish the new ritual-worker story. The requested 0.75 H height is an art-direction target, not canonical monster data.

records.name: Drowned Fieldhand
records.location: Act I · reinterpretation of the Diablo II Zombie
records.layout: 16:9 sheet: front, side, rear and elevated game views; attack pose, black silhouette and small game-scale view.
records.description: Human-sized former farm worker, sagging shoulders, dragging leg, torn wool and rope belt, cold grey skin with mud stains. One malformed stiff arm; restrained decay, no exposed entrails.
records.art: Two separated rows contain a neutral human reference, front, side, rear, elevated three-quarter view, attack pose, solid black monster silhouette, and small colored view. Figures are fully visible. The enlarged arm remains on the character's right and the hopper on the left across the readable views. Muted workwear, clay-stained pallid skin, rope belt, diagonal leather strap and rear wooden dibber communicate interrupted farm labor. No visible text, logo, watermark, scenery, armor, handheld weapon, extra limbs, or gratuitous gore.

records.name: Grave Hunger

records.description: Emaciated human undead, forward-thrust neck, long grasping arms, burial wraps and clotted earth, sunken grey face. Lean reaching silhouette distinct from shambling fieldhand.

records.name: Gameplay HUD
records.base: Night survivor camp behind the interface
records.layout: 16:9 full-screen mockup
records.description: A level 24 armoured knight fights three zombies on a wet moor road beside a firelit survivor camp. Three party portraits and red health bars sit at upper left; a line automap with a campfire marker sits at upper right. The top-centre monster plate reads “Hollowed Fieldhand.” A dropped ring has the yellow label “Warden's Ring.” A faint chat panel sits at lower left. The bottom HUD has red life and blue mana globes, carved dark stone and metal framing, two mouse-skill slots, eight numbered skill slots, four potion slots, and thin progress bars. Rendered skill and potion icons are visible.
records.art: Correct screen type: full main-gameplay HUD, with no inventory overlay. UI is textured medieval stone and metal; it does not look flat, modern, or sci-fi. Leather is subtle and less evident than the stone and metal. Major text is readable; no widespread garbling observed. Small decorative marks and fine lettering may lose clarity when reduced. The required three zombies, party frames, mouse skills, eight hotkeys, and four potion slots are visible. World lighting and materials broadly follow the references, although the scene is more detailed and realistically rendered than the low-detail gameplay reference.

records.name: Inventory & character
records.base: Night survivor camp behind the interface
records.layout: 16:9 full-screen mockup
records.description: A camp bonfire and survivors remain visible between two dark medieval UI panels. The left character panel shows attributes, combat values, life, mana, and coloured resistances. The right inventory panel has rendered equipment, two ring slots, a bag of weapons, armour, potions and supplies, and a gold count. A blue Sapphire Ring tooltip overlaps the equipment area. A bottom action bar is flanked by red life and blue mana glass orbs. Frames use weathered stone, blackened iron, rivets and dark leather details.
records.art: Correct screen type and physical medieval material treatment; no flat modern or sci-fi styling observed. Main labels, numbers and tooltip are readable; no widespread garbled text observed. Some tiny bottom-bar symbols are ambiguous at this resolution. The bag is an irregular set of item compartments rather than a clearly consistent 10×4 grid. The tooltip covers part of the shield/right equipment area. The world retains the reference camp composition and warm fire against cold vegetation, but is still fairly bright for a dimmed background. Rarity colours are demonstrated mainly by the blue ring tooltip;

records.description: A night survivor camp with a blacksmith at a lit forge behind the interface. A left Blacksmith vendor panel has Armour / Weapons / Misc tabs and rendered sale items. records.description: An in-game knight skill overlay on a weathered stone tablet with blackened iron borders, chain-linked round skill sockets, and leather side tabs. Main headings, counters, and tooltip text are readable; no widespread garbling is visible. Small bottom-bar numerals are cramped. The tooltip obscures several lower-right Auras sockets.
